title_zh: 约定复查租住房间的松动灯具

scenario.label_zh: 约定复查租住房间的松动灯具
scenario.goal_zh: 指出灯具缺陷与验收遗漏，并约定由电工检查后再决定处理

context_zh: 租客和房屋管理员在入住验收时发现灯具问题；他们只安排专业检查，不进行电气维修。
author: author-phase11-a

sentences.speaker: Dina
sentences.text: This light fixture moves when the door closes. There seems to be a flaw in the bracket.

sentences.speaker: Leo
sentences.text: The inspection report says everything was checked.

sentences.speaker: Dina
sentences.text: Then the inspection was flawed. It missed something we can see without touching the fitting.

sentences.speaker: Leo
sentences.text: I could add a note saying we will watch it.

sentences.speaker: Dina
sentences.text: That would be inadequate. I want an electrician to inspect it before we decide it is safe to use.

sentences.speaker: Leo
sentences.text: You're right. I'll arrange that and ask you not to use this light in the meantime.

sentences.speaker: Dina
sentences.text: Thank you. Please let me know the inspection time once you have it.
